headline: Stanley Lifestyles announces change in Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
summary: Stanley Lifestyles Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges about a change in its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. headline: Stanley Lifestyles clarifies volume jump to exchange
hook: Surge in Stanley share trading volume
summary: Stanley Lifestyles has responded to an NSE surveillance letter dated October 16, 2026, regarding a sudden increase in the trading volume of its shares. The company clarified its position to the exchange as part of standard regulatory procedure. Retail investors should note that volume spikes often precede corporate announcements or heightened market activity, though routine clarifications rarely impact fundamental value.
